dashboard.label: TA-baseline Overview
dashboard.description: Collects a host security baseline from the kernel/filesystem: UEFI SecureBoot state, kernel lockdown mode, SSH root-login and password-auth settings (sshd_config, including

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-baseline requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-baseline", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-baseline/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click a row to configure the key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M") | table host status last_reported note
| mstats avg("baseline.weak_ssh") as value where index=metrics span=5m by host | stats last(value) as v by host | stats sum(v) as value

panel.title: auditd active hosts (fleet sum, latest per host)

search.query: | mstats avg("baseline.auditd_active") as value where index=metrics span=5m by host | stats last(value) as v by host | stats sum(v) as value

panel.title: Kernel lockdown level (fleet avg, latest per host)

search.query: | mstats avg("baseline.lockdown") as value where index=metrics span=5m by host | stats last(value) as v by host | stats avg(v) as value
index=main sourcetype="baseline:status" | dedup host | table host auditd_active lockdown weak_ssh password_auth permit_root_login secure_boot
